info.name: Tabs External Billing Terms Reports API

params.name: limit
params.description: Max items per page. Defaults to 50. Values above 500 will be rejected.

params.name: filter
params.description:
Supported items for filter: startMonth, endMonth, currency.

            Months should be in YYYY-MM format. Set startMonth and endMonth to the same value to request a single month.

            By default the forecast is capped to 120 months ahead of the current month; pass endMonth to extend or shorten that horizon.

            Currency should be an ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, INR, EUR).

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated cash forecasting report showing due and paid amounts per period for each customer

params.name: limit
params.description: Max items per page. Defaults to 50. Values above 500 will be rejected.

params.name: filter
params.description:
Supported items for filter: startMonth, endMonth, customerId, currency.

            Months should be in YYYY-MM format.

            Currency should be an ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, INR, EUR).
